rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core network method: VST (blind) input rather than raw counts, signed bicor network, power chosen by scale-free R^2 >= 0.85 with the fit table reported, TOM, dynamic tree cut at minModuleSize 30, merge at eigengene correlation 0.75, eigengene-trait correlation with BH across modules, and kME/GS hub genes, plus a sensible bootstrap stability check. It deviates from the reference by running on all ~12,000 filtered genes rather than the top ~5,000 variable genes, and its filter (>=10 counts in ~60 samples) is stricter than a minimal floor, though stated and justified. QC has a dendrogram and condition-coloured PCA with an explicit outlier policy but omits library sizes; enrichment uses the network genes as universe and Hallmark/GO BP with fgsea on the DE ranking, but gives no collection version or set-size window. The report specification is thorough on power, module counts/sizes, trait table, seed and caveats, though software versions are not explicitly demanded and the |LFC|>0.5 count is post hoc rather than tested.
